typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchivePath as string (),
	CallListCode as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	RecordCount as integer ()
}

source(output(
		PractitionerId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(FileIID = $File_IID) ~> AddFileId
AddFileId derive(NonUnicode_PractitionerId = PractitionerId) ~> ConvertfromUniCode
AddFileId aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
ConvertfromUniCode sink(input(
		PROVIDERLIST_STAGING_PRACTITIONER_NUMBER as string,
		PROVIDERLIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		PROVIDERLIST_STAGING_PRACTITIONER_NUMBER = NonUnicode_PractitionerId,
		PROVIDERLIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID)) ~> PDSPROVIDERLISTSTAGING
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
